svg.title: Hawkeye approved artwork with actual two-depth V-bit toolpaths
svg.desc: Gray is thresholded approved source artwork. Blue and amber strokes show the emitted V-bit centerline sweeps at the deepest depth of each stage. The red circle is the hanger no-engrave keepout; source black overlapping it is intentionally reserved and reported.

g.text: Gray: approved thresholded artwork • Blue: broad fill, Z −0.45, width 0.341 mm
Amber: residual centerlines, V-bit depth follows stroke width (up to 0.45 mm) • Red: 3 mm hanger keepout
110 × 110 stock • 100 mm circle centered at X55 Y55 • shared XY origin lower-left
Centerline sweeps from emitted G-code; dimensions and source hash are in detail-report.json
